text: This week was flagged due to an elevated number of files copied to removable media by user ABP2917, Alice Britanney Pope. Specifically, 19 files were copied, which is above their typical range of 6.50 and even higher than their previous peak in the past 12 weeks at 17. While there are no other anomalies in their activity this week, such as unusual device connections or file operations, this sudden spike in removable media usage warrants further investigation to understand the purpose behind it.
